text_block_list.text:
Still in Love had lost. Yet, I couldn't 
find any reason for her defeat... She was 
perfect. If that's the case—

text_block_list.name: Spectator A
text_block_list.text:
For real~!? Still herself seemed to be in 
super great shape, though.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... A baffling defeat. It's hard to 
believe it was a lack of ability. —Perhaps 
it was a tactical blunder by the Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
And here I thought they were a promising 
prospect. This is a bit of a 
disappointment...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer, don't you think it's better to 
change it?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
...I am so sorry. Even after you placed so 
much faith in me...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I betrayed the fans' expectations, too... 
I...――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh...?
choice_data_list:
It's my fault for going too easy with my 
coaching...
It's because my guidance was too lax...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: T-Trainer?

—I was unimaginably shocked. The 
reporter's words I had overheard earlier 
kept echoing relentlessly in my head...
choice_data_list: I'm not good enough for you...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
“—Hey, Still in Love came this way, 
right?”

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
The fans are waiting for a quote! I'm 
gonna be the first one there!

text_block_list.name: Reporter C
text_block_list.text:
Still in Love-san's Traiiiner? Where are 
you~!

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: —Let's run away.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Over here...!

Following her lead, we slipped away from 
the racetrack... careful not to be spotted 
by the fans or the press.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Trainer-san, it's ice cream. Would 
you like some?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Mmm... Delicious...♪

Her gentle smile and the cold ice cream 
gradually brought me back to my senses... 
I felt mortified by my drunken behavior 
just moments ago.
choice_data_list: Sorry, I lost my cool for a second.
I'm sorry, I lost my composure.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Not at all. ...I was happy, you know.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It's not often you get to see Trainer-san 
look like that, after all...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...Trainer-san. I... want it to be you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I can give it my all because I'm with you. 
Because I'm with you... I can run.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
So please... don't say that you are 
unworthy.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I also fell short in some ways today. 
That's why...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
When you want to run away, run away with 
me. Once you get a change of pace...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Starting tomorrow, would you... continue 
to strive together with me?"

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. I'll become even 
stronger, so...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
—At the Oka Sho... please let me see your 
joy.
